ecological_question: Does recent rainfall expand the acoustically active frog community by recruiting additional species around a persistent route-level core, or by replacing species through turnover?
biological_hypothesis: Rainfall acts as a short environmental pulse that relaxes constraints on reproductive acoustic activity, producing nested expansion of the active community rather than wholesale compositional turnover.

eligibility.temperature: >=8 valid stop temperatures and run mean in [-10,45] C

pairing.rule: Within each stratum, sort eligible runs by SurveyYear and pair adjacent observed years. A run may contribute to at most two adjacent pairs.
pairing.orientation: For pairs with unequal DaysSinceRain, define the run with lower DaysSinceRain as the wetter run and the other as the drier run. Equal-rain pairs are excluded.

community_metrics.shared: number of species active in both runs
community_metrics.wet_only: number active only in wetter run
community_metrics.dry_only: number active only in drier run
community_metrics.gain_share: wet_only/(wet_only + dry_only), defined when discordant species >0
community_metrics.dry_core_retention: shared/(shared + dry_only), defined when drier-run richness >0

primary_models.richness_gain: OLS with cluster-robust SE by State:RouteNumber; richness_gain ~ rain_contrast + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + C(State) + C(RunNumber)
primary_models.nestedness_component: OLS with same predictors and clustering
primary_models.simpson_turnover: OLS with same predictors and clustering

descriptive_support.gain_loss_balance: Report total wet_only and dry_only counts across pairs and mean gain_share. This is descriptive because species discordances are not independent.
descriptive_support.dry_core_retention: Report mean and median retention of drier-run active species in wetter runs.

prediction.P1: Greater rainfall contrast predicts positive richness_gain.
prediction.P2: Greater rainfall contrast predicts increased nestedness_component.
prediction.P3: Greater rainfall contrast does not require increased simpson_turnover; a null or weaker turnover slope together with P1/P2 supports nested expansion.
prediction.P4: Across matched pairs, wetter runs retain a large fraction of the drier-run active species while adding more species than they lose.

interpretation_boundary: This analysis concerns acoustically active community composition, not census abundance or occupancy.
Calling activity is a reproductive-behaviour proxy and does not by itself establish breeding success.
The ecological extension is post-opening relative to the original rain endpoint and is not part of the original confirmatory family.
No causal rainfall claim is authorized.
